root.label: Victor Wembanyama rejects sports betting endorsements

events.label: Victor Wembanyama rejects sports betting endorsements

slots.name: player age
slots.sentence: Wembanyama, 22, has repeatedly been outspoken about several cultural and societal issues, from his rejection of soda products, to saying he was “horrified” of fatal shootings of civilians by federal immigration enforcement officers.

slots.name: gambling endorsement status
slots.sentence: “Absolutely not,” Wembanyama told reporters Thursday, Oct. 1 when asked if he would ever become a brand ambassador for a sports gambling company. “I would never do that. Honestly, I think it’s very sad to see some players promote it, in my opinion. Everybody does whatever they want, but without me.”
